title: Noether's Theorem: Why Every Symmetry Hides a Law of Nature
question: Why does the universe conserve energy, momentum, and charge — and are these laws separate coincidences, or one deep truth wearing three different masks?
summary: In 1915, a mathematician barred from a professorship because she was a woman proved that every conservation law in physics is secretly a statement about symmetry. It may be the most consequential theorem most people have never heard of.
